config.title: Debounced Search

intro.title: Debounced Search
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a real-time search input that filters a list of items as the user types, using a debounced function to optimize performance. You will learn how to implement debouncing to delay the execution of a search function, preventing excessive API calls or computations on every keystroke. The main technologies and constructs involved include Angular's template-driven forms, RxJS Observables, and the `debounceTime` operator. By the end, you'll have a functional, efficient search component that enhances user experience in Angular applications.
intro.usecase: Debounced search is a critical performance pattern in any UI where users type to filter or query data in real-time. You'll see it in e-commerce search bars, like on Amazon, to prevent sending an API request on every keystroke while users type product names. It's equally vital in admin dashboards with large data tables, where typing in a filter input should update results smoothly without jank. Implementing debounce ensures your application remains responsive and efficient, providing a polished user experience while reducing unnecessary server load.

objectives: Construct a reactive form with a search input field in an Angular component
Initialize a FormControl instance to manage the search input's value changes
Configure a debounce operator on the FormControl's valueChanges observable
Implement a subscription to handle debounced search value emissions
Bind the search results to the component template using Angular's data binding
Integrate a loading indicator that displays during debounce delays
Control subscription lifecycle to prevent memory leaks in the component

successCriteria: The input element in the template includes (input)="onSearchInput($event.target.value)" binding.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
